recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-6931. Any remaining work on preferred-contact deprecation or rank/contact-priority replacement should be tracked under the later applied issues and, where applicable, in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than by changing core for FHIR-6931.
issue_request: FHIR-6931 was a Published FHIR-core Organization change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It requested a boolean standard extension on Organization.contact to indicate the preferred contact for a specific purpose and asked that the Organization Contact Purpose value set binding be relaxed from required to a recommended extensible binding.
initial_application: Historical commit 608a3b87d0ba3f1e6b99d05d0be7def789cd49c0, "Tracker# 6931, organization standard extensions", added the preferredContact extension to Organization.contact and showed ContactPartyType using the contactentity-type value set with extensible strength. Later source history migrated the extension out of core.
additional_context: Organization is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Organization.contact is typed as ExtendedContactDetail, and ExtendedContactDetail.purpose binds to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/contactentity-type with preferred strength after later R5 decisions FHIR-29034 and FHIR-29035. The organization-preferredContact extension is now in the FHIR Extension Pack with retired/deprecated status and later FHIR-50768/FHIR-49912 replacement guidance pointing toward contact priority/rank-style handling.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source hunk is needed because the current build already carries the contact-purpose behavior through the active datatype, and the historical preferred-contact extension is no longer a core-owned build artifact.
